notes.title: Super Cricket Fighter Turbo - Update 1
notes.content:
[h2]Additions[/h2]
- Add 3 new achievements that can be unlocked by scoring against an AI opponent.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
- The achievements that require beating the computer cannot be unlocked by simply swapping input on the last point.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Gamepads are now properly recognized on Linux.
